claims: WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2) is at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2) is headlined by Roman Reigns defeating CM Punk for the World Heavyweight Championship.
WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2) featured a six-match card.
Rhea Ripley dethroned Jade Cargill at WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2).
Trick Williams won the US Title at WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2).
WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2) featured a Street Fight between "The Demon" Finn Bálor and Dominik Mysterio.
Roman Reigns def. CM Punk (c) at WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2).
WWE Women’s Championship: Rhea Ripley def. Jade Cargill (c) at WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2).
Trick Williams def. Sami Zayn (c) at WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2).
"The Demon" Finn Bálor def. Dominik Mysterio at WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2).
Penta (c) def. Rey Mysterio, Je'Von Evans, Dragon Lee, JD McDonagh, and Rusev at WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2).
Oba Femi def. Brock Lesnar at WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2).
The main event of WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2) is Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk.
The opener of WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2) is Oba Femi vs. Brock Lesnar.
Dominik Mysterio vs. "The Demon" Finn Bálor was changed to a Street Fight just before WrestleMania 42 Sunday (Night 2).
